title: A Spare Part for More Than One Problem
title_ja: 複数の問題に役立つ予備部品
fact_notes: 人物・施設・活動・結果は架空の事例。実在の統計や研究結果ではない。個別の法律・工学手順の説明を目的としない。参考リンクは制作台帳であり、実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: For an imaginary space mission, a high school engineering club was asked to prepare a limited collection of emergency supplies.
sentences.ja: 架空の宇宙任務に向け、高校の技術部は限られた緊急用品を準備するよう求められた。

sentences.en: The students could select items from a table containing small tools, connecting pieces, containers, and several kinds of protective material.
sentences.ja: 生徒は小型工具、接続部品、容器、数種類の保護材が並ぶ机から品物を選べた。

sentences.en: Their teacher explained that the exercise represented a situation in which a crew could not quickly request extra equipment from home.
sentences.ja: 先生は、この課題が乗組員がすぐに本拠地から追加の機器を取り寄せられない状況を表していると説明した。

sentences.en: The activity was a simplified design challenge rather than an accurate model of professional spacecraft engineering.
sentences.ja: 活動は専門的な宇宙船工学の正確なモデルではなく、簡略化された設計課題だった。

sentences.en: One team initially selected a different specialized tool for each of the problems described in the mission instructions.
sentences.ja: あるチームは当初、任務の指示に記された問題ごとに異なる専用工具を選んだ。

sentences.en: However, the total number of items quickly exceeded the limit established by the teacher.
sentences.ja: しかし品物の総数はすぐに教師が決めた上限を超えた。

sentences.en: Another student suggested searching for simple components that might serve several purposes if combined in different ways.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は組み合わせ方によって複数の用途に使える簡単な部品を探すよう提案した。

sentences.en: The group compared the advantages of carrying specialized equipment with those of carrying more flexible materials.
sentences.ja: グループは専用機器を持つ利点と、より柔軟に使える材料を持つ利点を比較した。

sentences.en: During the first simulated emergency, the students needed to attach a loose container to the wall of their model spacecraft.
sentences.ja: 最初の模擬緊急事態で、生徒は固定されていない容器を模型宇宙船の壁に取り付ける必要があった。

sentences.en: They successfully completed the task using a pair of adjustable straps that they had added to their supply collection.
sentences.ja: 備品に加えた調節可能なベルト一組で作業を完了した。

sentences.en: Later, when a different task involved securing several small objects together, the same type of strap proved useful again.
sentences.ja: その後、複数の小物を固定する別の作業でも同じ種類のベルトが再び役立った。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, the students encountered another challenge that could not reasonably be solved with the flexible materials alone.
sentences.ja: それでも柔軟な材料だけでは合理的に解決できない別の課題に直面した。

sentences.en: The team therefore decided that its second collection should include both adaptable components and a few carefully selected specialized tools.
sentences.ja: そこで第二の備品セットには汎用性のある部品と慎重に選んだ専用工具の両方を入れることにした。

sentences.en: Before beginning a new simulation, they wrote down which problems each item might help address and which limitations it had.
sentences.ja: 新しい模擬活動を始める前に、各品物がどの問題に役立ち、どのような限界を持つか書き留めた。

sentences.en: They also practiced using the items safely within the classroom rules rather than assume that every imaginable use was acceptable.
sentences.ja: 想像できる用途がすべて許容されると決めつけず、教室の規則内で安全に使う練習もした。

sentences.en: The second exercise encouraged the students to think about combinations of resources instead of evaluating every object separately.
sentences.ja: 第二の課題は物を個別に評価するだけでなく、資源の組み合わせを考えるよう促した。

sentences.en: The club learned that versatility can be valuable when available resources are limited, but it cannot eliminate every need for specialization.
sentences.ja: 部員は利用可能な資源が限られると汎用性が有用になり得るが、専門性の必要をすべてなくせるわけではないと学んだ。

sentences.en: A solution that works under one set of conditions may fail when the requirements of a task change.
sentences.ja: ある条件で機能する解決策も、作業の要件が変われば失敗する場合がある。

sentences.en: Planning for an uncertain future involves identifying multiple possible uses while recognizing the boundaries of each option.
sentences.ja: 不確かな未来への準備には、各選択肢の限界を認識しつつ複数の用途を見つけることが含まれる。

sentences.en: For the students, the most useful collection was not simply the smallest one but the one that addressed the widest range of realistic needs.
sentences.ja: 生徒にとって最も有用な備品は単に最小のセットではなく、現実的な必要性に最も幅広く対応するセットだった。

questions.prompt: What was the club asked to prepare?
options: A limited collection of emergency supplies.
A real spacecraft for launch.
A list of professional astronauts.
A complete map of every planet.
questions.explanation_ja: 限定された緊急用品を準備。

questions.prompt: What situation was the teacher trying to model?
options: A spacecraft with unlimited resources.
A mission requiring no preparation.
A crew unable to obtain new equipment quickly.
A crew with immediate access to every tool.
questions.explanation_ja: 追加機器をすぐ得られない状況。

questions.prompt: Why did the first selection need to change?
options: The teacher had prohibited all tools.
The number of items exceeded the limit.
No instructions had been given.
Every selected item had been broken.

questions.prompt: What alternative did another student propose?
options: Removing all protective materials without replacement.
Selecting only the heaviest equipment.
Using every tool separately for only one task.
Choosing components that could serve several purposes.
questions.explanation_ja: 複数用途の部品を探した。

questions.prompt: How did the group attach the loose container?
options: Using a printed map.
Using a different classroom wall.
Using adjustable straps.
Using an empty notebook.
questions.explanation_ja: 調節可能なベルトで固定した。

questions.prompt: What limitation became clear in the later challenge?
options: Some problems still required more specialized solutions.
Flexible materials never worked in any task.
Every problem could be solved using only straps.
The students could ignore all safety rules.
questions.explanation_ja: 汎用材料だけでは解けない課題があった。

questions.prompt: What did they include in their second collection?
options: Only specialized tools for the first task.
Only straps and no other items.
Every object from the original table.
Adaptable components and selected specialized tools.
questions.explanation_ja: 汎用部品と専用工具を併用。

questions.prompt: What did the students document before another simulation?
options: The price of every spacecraft ever built.
Possible uses and limitations of each item.
The names of all professional engineers.
The time needed to travel to Mars.
questions.explanation_ja: 各品物の用途と限界を書いた。

questions.prompt: What does versatility most nearly mean?
options: Ability to serve different purposes.
Inability to change under any conditions.
A requirement to use one specialized tool.
An exact count of available objects.
questions.explanation_ja: 多様な用途に対応する能力。

options: The smallest collection is always the best one.
Space crews should never carry specialized equipment.
Effective planning balances adaptable resources with tools suited to specific needs.
All materials can safely perform any possible function.
questions.explanation_ja: 汎用性と特定用途への対応を両立する。

grammar.focus: in which a crew could not quickly request extra equipment
grammar.explanation_ja: in whichはsituationを修飾する関係表現。
if節では主語とbe動詞が省略されている。

grammar.focus: that could not reasonably be solved
grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞thatと受動態could be solved。

grammar.focus: but it cannot eliminate every need for specialization

discourse.role_ja: 初期計画と数量制限を対比。
成功例に加えて汎用性の限界を示す。
限界を踏まえ備品の組み合わせを変更。

paraphrases.source: Their teacher explained that the exercise represented a situation in which a crew could not quickly request extra equipment from home.
paraphrases.rewrite: The teacher said the activity modeled circumstances where additional equipment could not be obtained promptly.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: すぐに物資を得られない状況を模した。

paraphrases.source: Another student suggested searching for simple components that might serve several purposes if combined in different ways.
paraphrases.rewrite: A student proposed looking for basic parts that could perform multiple functions when put together differently.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 組み合わせで用途を広げる案。

paraphrases.source: Nevertheless, the students encountered another challenge that could not reasonably be solved with the flexible materials alone.
paraphrases.rewrite: They still faced a problem for which their adaptable materials were insufficient.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 汎用材料だけでは不足する問題もあった。

paraphrases.source: The club learned that versatility can be valuable when available resources are limited, but it cannot eliminate every need for specialization.
paraphrases.rewrite: Although multipurpose items can help when supplies are scarce, some specialized equipment may still be necessary.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 汎用性があっても専門工具が必要な場合がある。
